question: Which writ literally means 'what is your authority’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quo-Warranto**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Quo-Warranto** literally means 'what is your authority?'.
 
• This writ is issued to inquire into the legality of the claim of a person to a public office.
